name: Elon Musk's Tesla Roadster
tagline: A red sports car with a spacesuited mannequin at the wheel, in orbit around the Sun since Falcon Heavy's first flight
description: Elon Musk's Tesla Roadster was the payload of Falcon Heavy's first flight on 2018-02-06: a midnight-cherry sports car flown as a mass simulator in place of the steel or concrete blocks normally used. At the wheel sits Starman, a full-scale mannequin in a white-and-black SpaceX spacesuit, one hand on the wheel and an elbow on the window sill. The car was mounted at an incline above the payload adapter, inside a conventional fairing, and three cameras on booms streamed live video for just over four hours. A Hot Wheels Roadster with a mini Starman sits on the dashboard beside a "DON'T PANIC" sign, and a plaque on the attachment fitting carries the names of more than 6,000 SpaceX employees. Its mass is given as about 1,250 kg with batteries (JPL Horizons) or 1,300 kg at launch (Wikipedia). JPL Horizons lists it as "Tesla Roadster (AKA: Starman, 2018-017A)". It orbits the Sun between 0.986 au and about 1.67 au, and passed Mars at about 7.4 million km on 2020-10-07.
best_known_for: A red sports car with a spacesuited mannequin at the wheel, sent into orbit around the Sun on Falcon Heavy's first flight
